text_encoder_fallback.notes: The Comfy-Org fp8 umT5 single file is tried first. If diffusers cannot load it, the node uses the umT5 weights in the diffusers repo. That is an extra download of several gigabytes and must stay off the GPU while an expert is resident.

negative_prompt: jitter, flicker, frame stutter, warping, morphing, face distortion, deformed eyes, deformed mouth, asymmetric eyes, extra limbs, extra fingers, fused fingers, identity drift, melting skin, rubbery skin, plastic skin, blurry face, temporal inconsistency, camera shake, watermark, text, logo, subtitles, low quality
